title: 杀戮尖塔2：分道争锋 / Separate Paths
description:
[h1]杀戮尖塔2：分道争锋 / Separate Paths[/h1]

[b]需要 public-beta 测试分支[/b]
Steam → 游戏属性 → Game Versions & Betas → public-beta。当前正式分支的关键 API 与测试分支不兼容；只保持玩家游戏版本一致还不足以加载本模组。所有玩家必须使用相同游戏版本、相同模组版本，并安装、启用 BaseLib 3.4.7 或更新版本（已验证 3.4.7）。

共享地图、独立选路与独立战斗的五幕多人竞速。献祭当前遗物奖励，从诅咒对手、双刃契约、强化自身的混合池中三选一；率先击败第五幕高塔之心者获胜。
65项可配置效果，队友生命/牌组/遗物展示、彩色通关标记、房主保存与恢复。游戏内跟随游戏语言显示中文或英文。首次安装请勿同时保留本地同ID副本。

[b]Requires the public-beta branch[/b]
Steam → Properties → Game Versions & Betas → public-beta. The default public branch has incompatible game APIs. Using the same game version as your friends is necessary, but does not make the default branch compatible. All players need the same game version, the same mod version, and BaseLib 3.4.7 or later installed and enabled (tested with 3.4.7).

Race through five acts on a shared map with independent paths and battles. Sacrifice a relic reward to choose one of three effects from a mixed pool: Curse your opponents, take a Double-edged Contract, or gain a Boon. Be the first to defeat the Heart of the Spire in Act 5.
65 configurable effects; teammate HP, deck and relic details; colored map completion marks; host-managed saving and recovery. Chinese and English text follows your game language. Do not keep a manual installation alongside the Workshop copy with the same mod ID.

0.5.1 好友测试版 / Friends-only preview. Verified API baseline: game v0.111.0 public-beta. Special events and third-party mod combinations are not exhaustively tested.
changeNote: 0.5.1：新增游戏内英文，保留中文并跟随游戏语言；补充双语工坊介绍。核验正式/测试分支 API 后，以 public-beta 为兼容基准，保留必要最低版本门槛。 / Added English game text and a bilingual Workshop description. Confirmed API differences between branches; public-beta remains required.
